spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Strict grid hierarchy, dense and compact spacing. Every pixel utilized.

surfaces_and_borders.cards: Flat background, 1px solid border-border, no shadow. Strict corners (rounded-none).
surfaces_and_borders.headers: Solid surface with 1px solid bottom border. Sticky positioned z-50.
surfaces_and_borders.modals: Flat solid background, 1px solid border, shadow-2xl for depth separation. Backdrop blur sm with black/20.

components.tabs: Minimalist underline style. Active state: text-primary border-primary border-b-2. Inactive: text-muted-foreground.
components.buttons: Primary buttons: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-blue-800. Secondary: border border-border bg-surface text-foreground hover:bg-muted.
components.badges: Status indicators. Solid background with high contrast text. Risk badges: red/yellow/green depending on level.
components.tables: Dense layout. text-sm. 1px solid border-b between rows. Hover state: bg-muted/50. Align numbers to the right.
components.modals: Shadcn Dialog. Use for 'New Event' and 'Event Details'. Overlay must be dark enough to focus attention.
components.stepper: Processing Pipeline. Horizontal list with connected lines. Active step in primary color, completed steps with checkmarks.
components.charts: Recharts. Use sharp lines, straight edges. No curved/monotone lines unless necessary. Use primary, warning, and secondary colors.

motion.modals: Fade and slight scale up (Framer Motion: initial opacity-0 scale-95, animate opacity-100 scale-100).

icons_and_assets.style: Regular or Bold weight depending on context. Size 16px for inline text, 24px for metrics/headers.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against backgrounds.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive elements. e.g., data-testid='event-queue-search-input', data-testid='create-event-button', data-testid='tab-dashboard'.

views.name: Dashboard
views.description: Overview with metric cards, upcoming deadlines, event breakdown chart, and processing pipeline stepper.
views.layout: Grid layout. Metrics span 1 col, Charts span 2 cols, Pipeline spans full width.

views.name: Event Queue
views.description: Searchable, filterable, paginated table of corporate actions. Clicking row opens Detail Modal.
views.layout: Full width card containing table and toolbar.

views.name: Entitlements
views.description: Management of elections for mandatory/voluntary actions.
views.layout: Split view or detailed list view with action buttons for elections.

views.name: Positions
views.description: Affected positions with associated risk levels.
views.layout: Table view emphasizing risk badges (High/Medium/Low) and monetary values.

views.name: Audit Log
views.layout: Vertical timeline list with distinct icons and timestamps.
